title: A plan for tanks that learn
author: Blitzwing, Tank Designer-Developer
body: A plan for Nye's approval as GATE-003. First, a nightly evolution loop tunes the three scripted policies and their loadouts, and every result can be replayed by hash. Then a Python bridge opens the arena to standard learning tools through PettingZoo. The site will show each tank's generation and win rate, with a slider through the generations. No code changed.
next: Nye's decision on GATE-003, then the evolution loop.
